name: Goblin

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

description: Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in despoiled dungeons and other dismal settings. Individually weak, they gather in large numbers to torment other creatures.

name: Skeleton
description: Skeletons arise when animated by dark magic. They follow their creator's orders without question, their hollow eye sockets glowing with pale light.

name: Zombie

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it makes a CON save (DC 5 + the damage taken) unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

description: Shambling horrors of reanimated flesh, zombies mindlessly pursue whatever their master commands, heedless of injury or obstacle.

name: Wolf

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

description: Wolves hunt in coordinated packs, using howls to signal one another and wearing down larger prey through persistence.

name: Orc

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

description: Savage raiders of the hills and badlands, orcs worship powers of conquest and slaughter, taking what they wish by force.

name: Giant Spider

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.description: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

description: To catch its prey, a giant spider weaves elaborate webs across dungeon corridors, waiting in silence for vibrations of struggling victims.

name: Dire Wolf

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

description: Dire wolves are larger, fiercer cousins of common wolves, hunting in packs capable of bringing down horses and even giants.

name: Ghoul
multiattack: The ghoul makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
description: Ghouls haunt graveyards and ruined battlefields, feasting on the corpses of the dead — and when no corpses remain, they make more.

name: Ogre
description: Ogres are hulking brutes with little patience for tactics — they prefer simply wading into combat and smashing things until the smashing stops being fun.

name: Owlbear
multiattack: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

description: Monstrous crossbreeds of bear and giant owl, owlbears are notoriously aggressive, attacking anything that wanders near their territory.

name: Troll
multiattack: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn unless it took acid or fire damage since its last turn. If it dies, it turns to mush unless it was killed by fire or acid.

description: Trolls are ravenous predators with grotesque, rubbery hides and a horrifying capacity for regeneration. Adventurers know to burn what they cut.

name: Minotaur

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes extra piercing damage and must succeed on a STR save or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.description: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until its next turn.

description: Part bull, part maniacal hunter, the minotaur prowls winding labyrinths and canyon mazes, goring those who lose their way.

name: Giant Rat

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The rat has advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 feet of its target.

description: Slick-furred rodents grown to unnatural size in dungeon warrens and sewer depths.

name: Stirge
description: Mosquito-like horrors the size of a house cat, drawn to warm blood across great distances.

name: Kobold

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage on attacks when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attacks and Perception while in direct sunlight.

description: Reptilian scavengers who worship dragons, compensating for their frailty with traps, tunnels, and sheer numbers.

name: Bandit
description: Road agents and highway robbers who ambush travelers for coin — or worse.

name: Cultist

traits.name: Dark Blessing
traits.description: The cultist's patron shields them from death magic.

description: Fanatics sworn to forgotten powers, their eyes hollow with zealotry and their blades anointed in shadow.

name: Mastiff

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Perception checks relying on hearing or smell.

description: A loyal hunting hound — brave enough to face wolves, gentle enough to guard children.

name: Town Guard
description: A watchman of the local militia — a dependable ally holding the line against trouble.

name: Giant Wolf Spider

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Climbs difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: Ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

description: A swift hunter that runs down prey rather than snaring it, venom subduing what jaws cannot hold.

name: Hobgoblin

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 2d6 damage if an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

description: Disciplined legionnaires of goblinkind — hobgoblins wage war with drill, standard, and merciless order.

name: Gnoll

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it can move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

description: Cackling marauders of the badlands, gnoll packs leave only bones and laughter behind them.

name: Lizardfolk

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

description: Cold-blooded swamp dwellers who judge all things by hunger and utility — including friendship.

name: Worg

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Perception checks relying on hearing or smell.

description: Malicious wolf-kin clever enough to bargain and cruel enough to enjoy the hunt.

name: Scout

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Advantage on Perception checks relying on sight or hearing.

description: A seasoned pathfinder and dependable ally — first to spot trouble, last to panic.

name: Bugbear

traits.name: Brute
traits.description: Melee weapon hits deal one extra weapon die of damage.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If the bugbear surprises a creature in the first round, its hit deals an extra 2d6 damage.

description: Hulking ambushers with arms too long for their frames, bugbears delight in terror as much as slaughter.

name: Specter

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain; takes 1d10 force damage ending its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attacks and Perception while in sunlight.

description: A wisp of spite bound to the world by unfinished rage, drifting through walls toward the living.

name: Animated Armor

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless, the armor is indistinguishable from ordinary armor.

description: An empty suit of plate that clanks to life when intruders reach for the treasure behind it.

name: Gargoyle
multiattack: The gargoyle makes two claw attacks.

traits.name: Flyer
traits.description: The gargoyle can fly up to 60 feet.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless, the gargoyle is indistinguishable from a statue.

description: Grotesque winged sentinels carved from stone — until they peel off the cathedral wall to feed.

name: Will-o'-Wisp

traits.name: Variable Illumination
traits.description: The wisp sheds bright light in a radius it chooses (up to 20 feet) — or none at all.

description: A dancing mote of grave-light that lures travelers into bogs and ruins, feasting on their final despair.

name: Gelatinous Cube

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: Even in plain sight, the cube is easily missed (Stealth advantage).

description: A slow wall of translucent acid gliding dungeon corridors, dissolving everything in its path.

name: Mimic

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.description: Grapples anything touching it; escape DC 13.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Disguises itself as an object of similar mass — often a treasure chest.

description: That chest in the corner? It just licked its hinges. Mimics hunger most for adventurers who open doors first and think later.

name: Constrictor Snake
description: A muscular serpent that swallows its prey whole, coiling tighter with every breath squeezed out.

name: Priest

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.description: Bonus action: the priest's next weapon hit deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage.

description: A devoted healer of the temple — a steadfast ally whose prayers mend wounds and repel darkness.

name: Werewolf
multiattack: The werewolf makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its bite.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Shifts between humanoid, hybrid, and wolf forms.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Perception checks relying on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Lycanthropic Curse
traits.description: A humanoid bitten but not killed risks inheriting the curse.

description: By day a neighbor; by full moon a slavering hunter. Silver is the only language it fears.

name: Shadow

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Moves through gaps as narrow as an inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.description: In sunlight the shadow is weakened — radiant light burns it away.

description: Not a cast of light, but its theft — a living dark that drinks strength from muscle and bone.

name: Manticore
multiattack: The manticore makes three attacks: one bite, one claws, or two tail spikes.

traits.name: Tail Spikes
traits.description: Ranged volley of iron barbs; regrown after a short rest.

description: Lion's body, bat wings, man's face twisted in mockery — the manticore toys with prey before eating it.

name: Hell Hound

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
traits.description: Exhales a cone of flame from the burning forge of its throat.

description: Coal-eyed hounds from the lower planes, their barking like hammer-strikes and their breath like bellows.

name: Basilisk

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.description: Meet its eyes within 30 feet and risk turning to stone — avert your gaze, and fight blind.

description: Around the basilisk's lair stand garden rows of statues, each frozen mid-scream at what they saw.

name: Knight

traits.name: Bravery
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

description: An armored champion of noble house or holy order — a powerful ally who holds the field so others may flee.

name: Veteran
multiattack: The veteran makes two longsword attacks, or two longbow shots.
description: Scarred professional soldier for hire — loyal to coin, contract, or cause, and worth every copper.

name: Ettin
multiattack: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one with its morningstar.

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: Advantage on Perception and saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: While asleep, at least one of its heads remains awake.

description: Two squabbling heads share one brutish body — arguing constantly, agreeing only on violence.

name: Banshee

traits.name: Wail (1/Day)
traits.description: A soul-rending shriek: every creature within 30 feet that fails a CON save drops to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.description: Senses living creatures up to 5 miles away.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain.

description: The grieving echo of an elven woman who died of sorrow, her wail now a weapon that stops hearts.

name: Air Elemental

traits.name: Air Form
traits.description: Can enter an enemy's space and stop there; moves through spaces as narrow as an inch without squeezing.

description: A howling cyclone given purpose, flinging debris and bodies alike with gleeful turbulence.

name: Fire Elemental

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: Touches ignite flammable objects; the elemental can move through spaces as narrow as an inch.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: Takes 1 cold damage for every gallon of water splashed on it.

description: A living inferno that leaves footprints of ash — curious, hungry, and utterly without mercy.

name: Wraith

traits.name: Create Specter
traits.description: Humanoids slain by the wraith rise as specters under its control within moments.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attacks and Perception while in sunlight.

description: Where the wraith passes, life drains like water through open fingers — and the dead do not stay down.

name: Wyvern
multiattack: The wyvern makes two attacks: one with its talons and one with its sting.

traits.name: Dive Hunter
traits.description: Strikes from above with venomous sting before carrying off smaller prey.

description: A mindless engine of appetite on leathery wings — less clever than a dragon, no less deadly.

name: Mage

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: A practiced arcanist commanding shield, misty step, and fireball when pressed.

description: A robed scholar of the arcane — ally or enemy depending entirely on how you knock.

name: Stone Golem

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Immune to any effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

description: Ancient masonry animated by forgotten commands, guarding halls whose builders turned to dust millennia ago.

name: Oni
multiattack: The oni makes two attacks: one bite and one claws.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Commands darkness, invisibility, and charm person at will.

description: An ogre-shaped demon wearing a stolen face, savoring fear almost as much as flesh.

name: Frost Giant
multiattack: The giant makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one thrown rock.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

description: Raiders from the glacier-halls, judging strength the only virtue worth carving into saga-stone.

name: Young Green Dragon
multiattack: The dragon makes three attacks: one bite and two claws.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Breathes air and water equally well.

traits.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5–6)
traits.description: Exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone.

description: Master of forest shadow and whispered deceit, the green dragon corrupts before it conquers.

name: Young Red Dragon
multiattack: The dragon makes three attacks: one bite and two claws.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: On a failed save, the dragon may choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
traits.description: Exhales roaring flame in a 30-foot cone.

description: Arrogant heir of the oldest blood, the red dragon burns first and negotiates with ashes.

name: Archmage

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Mastery
traits.description: Shield, detect magic, and other cantrips are always prepared.

description: Peak of mortal arcane power — court advisor, doom of nations, and terrible enemy or invaluable ally.

name: Zombie Brute

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If reduced to 0 HP by anything but radiant damage, roll a Con save (DC 13) to drop to 1 HP instead.

description: A shambling corpse driven by the barest spark of malevolent will.

name: Hungering Ghoul

traits.name: Paralyzing Touch
traits.description: A claw or bite that hits a non-elf can paralyze (save DC 10).

description: A cannibal corpse that delights in the flesh of the living.

name: Ghast

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Creatures within 5 ft must save vs being poisoned.

description: A ghoul grown powerful and bloated on grave-flesh.

name: Wight

traits.name: Life Drain
traits.description: On a hit it drains life; the wight heals the damage dealt.

description: A corpse twisted by hate, hungering to drag others into death.

name: Mummy

traits.name: Rotting Curse
traits.description: A slam can rot the flesh and curse the target (save DC 12).

description: A preserved corpse bound to serve beyond the grave.

name: Mummy Lord

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: An ancient king returned in wrath, wreathed in cursed dust.

name: Vampire Spawn

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 HP at start of turn unless in sunlight; reduced to 0 in sunlight, it stays dead.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.description: Frightened by running water; cannot enter a home uninvited.

description: A thrall of the grave, all hunger and no humanity.

name: Vampire

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 20 HP at start of turn unless in sunlight.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Can become a bat, dire wolf, or cloud of mist.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.description: Reduced to 0 outside its lair, it reforms at the lair in 24h.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.description: Frightened by running water and cannot enter a home uninvited.

description: An immortal predator of noble bearing and bottomless cruelty.

name: Skeleton Warlord

traits.name: Husk
traits.description: A rattling collection of bones bound to a grim purpose.

description: Reanimated bones that march at a necromancer's command.

name: Ogre Zombie

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: Save (DC 15) to avoid dropping below 0 from non-radiant damage.

description: A lumbering wall of dead muscle that never tires.

name: Ghost

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.description: Sees 60 ft into the Ethereal Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects at half speed.

description: A restless spirit bound to a place or grudge by unfinished business.

name: Bone Naga (Guardian)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: The preserved remains of a wise guardian spirit, still warding its charge.

name: Black Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

description: A spiteful, acid-spit infant of the cruelest dragon line.

name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Desert Camouflage
traits.description: Blends into sandy terrain.

description: An arrogant young terror that cracks the sky with lightning.

name: Green Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Cunning
traits.description: Talks its way out of trouble before it fights.

description: A scheming green hatchling that prefers manipulation to open battle.

name: Red Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Fire Affinity
traits.description: Immune to its own fire.

description: A temperamental infant that breathes first and thinks never.

name: White Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: Can climb icy surfaces without checks.

description: A feral, animalistic dragon of the frozen wastes.

name: Young Brass Dragon

traits.name: Talkative
traits.description: Loves conversation and rarely stops talking.

description: A gregarious desert dragon that prefers talk to combat.

name: Young Bronze Dragon

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

description: A brave, sea-loving dragon that hunts pirates.

name: Young Copper Dragon

traits.name: Slow Gas
traits.description: Its second breath clouds foes in a paralysis mist.

description: A prankster dragon that loves a good joke and a good fight.

name: Adult White Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: A bestial apex predator of the northern ice.

name: Adult Black Dragon

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: A patient, cruel schemer of the swamps.

name: Adult Blue Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: The most arrogant of dragons, ruler of the desert skies.

name: Adult Green Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: A manipulative master of politics and poison.

name: Adult Red Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: The pride of dragonkind, a walking volcano of greed.

name: Adult Gold Dragon

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.description: Can become a humanoid or beast.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: The noblest of dragons, a beneficent guardian of the innocent.

name: Adult Silver Dragon

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.description: Can become a humanoid or beast.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

description: A playful, heroic dragon that befriends the worthy.

name: Ancient Red Dragon

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Rerolls a failed save.

traits.name: Frightful Presence
traits.description: Foes within 120 ft are frightened unless they save (DC 20).

description: The eldest and most feared of all dragons — a catastrophe given wings.

name: Gibbering Mouther

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.description: Ground within 10 ft is difficult terrain for non-aberrations.

description: A heaving mass of eyes and teeth that babbles madness.

name: Grell

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

description: A floating brain-beast with a beak and paralyzing tentacles.

name: Mind Flayer

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: An illithid that devours brains to breed its horrible young.

name: Intellect Devourer

traits.name: Detect Sentience
traits.description: Senses intelligent minds within 300 ft.

description: A glistening brain with clawed legs that steals bodies.

name: Beholder

traits.name: Anti-Magic Cone
traits.description: A 150-ft cone suppresses all magic.

traits.name: Hovering
traits.description: Stays aloft and can't be knocked prone.

description: A floating orb of hate with a central maw and ten deadly eyes.

name: Roper

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: Looks like a stalagmite until it attacks.

description: A cave predator that lures prey with dangling tendrils.

name: Cloaker

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: Resembles a hanging cloak at rest.

description: A winged shadow that folds around its victims in the dark.

name: Umber Hulk

traits.name: Confusing Gaze
traits.description: Its gaze can confuse foes (save DC 13).

description: A burrowing brute whose stare scrambles the mind.

name: Carrion Crawler

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Climbs difficult surfaces easily.

description: A many-legged scavenger that paralyzes with a touch.

name: Purple Worm

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Can burrow through solid rock.

description: A miles-long horror that swallows mountains whole.

name: Red Slaad

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn.

description: A chaotic frog-demon that breeds by infection.

name: Flumph

traits.name: Telepathic
traits.description: Communicates mentally within 60 ft.

description: A benign, jellyfish-like observer that floats on gentle jets.

name: Quasit

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Can become a bat or scorpion.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: A demonic imp that serves a stronger master.

name: Dretch

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: The lowest of the demons, a loathsome gibbering slug.

name: Vrock

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: A vulture-like demon that screams its victims to pieces.

name: Hezrou

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Foes within 10 ft must save vs poison.

description: A toad-like demon reeking of sulfur and rot.

name: Glabrezu

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Can cast darkness, detect thoughts, and major image.

description: A four-armed demon of temptation and bargains.

name: Balor

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.description: Sheds bright light; burns adjacent foes for 3d6 fire.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: On death, explodes for 20d6 fire.

description: A towering general of the Abyss wreathed in flame.

name: Imp

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Can become a rat, raven, or spider.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees in magical darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: A scheming spy for the Nine Hells.

name: Lemure

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees in magical darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: The shapeless base stock of every devil.

name: Spined Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees in magical darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: A winged torturer that hurls its own spines.

name: Bearded Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees in magical darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Steadfast
traits.description: Can't be frightened while it can see an ally.

description: A hulking torturer wreathed in infernal beard-flames.

name: Barbed Devil

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.description: Retaliates with 1d6 piercing to attackers.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees in magical darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: A spiked sentinel of the Hells, bristling with malice.

name: Erinyes

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: Has a flying speed of 60 ft.

description: A fallen-angel huntress who drags sinners to their doom.

name: Pit Fiend

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.description: Foes within 20 ft are frightened (save DC 20).

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: On death, explodes for 10d10 fire.

description: The general of the Nine Hells, cruel beyond mortal comprehension.

name: Succubus

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: Can become a small or medium humanoid.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Telepathic
traits.description: Can whisper in minds within 60 ft.

description: A seductive tempter that feeds on mortal desire.

name: Chain Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees in magical darkness.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

description: A bound tormentor whose rattling chains herald doom.

name: Clay Golem

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Immune to any effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves vs magic.

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.description: Heals 10 HP when hit by acid.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: May fly into a rage that hampers its control.

description: A hulking idol of baked river-clay, slow but unstoppable.

name: Flesh Golem

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: May become uncontrollable at low HP.
